valores.label: Cost of the highway, per the 1986 plan ('approximately $8,000,000')

fonte: Monterey County, Big Sur Coast Land Use Plan (Local Coastal Program), 1986 (cópia do govinfo, CZIC)
legenda: In the dollars of the time.
credito_sugerido: Source: Monterey County, Big Sur Coast Land Use Plan, 1986
nota: P [1232] e P [1233]. Dólares correntes de 1937, sem correção pela inflação (não há decisão escrita para corrigir). A FHWA dá outra régua: 'The initial $1.5 million estimate… became $10 million nineteen years later' (a Highway One), que fica fora.

pedidos.pedido: P [1232]: 'the highway was completed at a cost of approximately $8,000,000' (R127); P [1233]–[1234]: 'A way of life had ended, and a new era began' (R128). Tela ≈ $8 MILLION · MONTEREY COUNTY PLAN (1986).
